# Khadeeja Designs
> Handcrafted Aari embroidery and bridal blouse designs from a boutique studio in Trichy (Tiruchirappalli), Tamil Nadu. Custom orders with delivery across India.

## Key facts
- Business: Khadeeja Designs
- Location: 17 East Sayakara Lane, Jaffersha Street, Trichy 620008
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 86674 54391
- Email: contact@khadeejadesigns.in
- Hours: 9 am to 8 pm, Monday to Saturday
- Ordering: enquire, receive quote, confirm design brief, pay advance, courier your blouse or saree, receive it back tracked
- Design range: visible listings from ₹1,999 to ₹8,499 across the Explore collection
- Services: bridal Aari blouse embroidery, custom embroidery, saree blouse design and finishing
- Social: https://instagram.com/khadeeja.designs
